How pricing works

Every project, support request, and repair is different, so we quote after we understand the work rather than publishing one-size-fits-all prices.

  • Websites and software: a written quote after an initial consultation, based on scope, features, and timeline.
  • IT support: one-time sessions or a recurring arrangement for your team, agreed before the first session.
  • Repairs and upgrades: diagnosis first, then a quote that lists parts and labor separately for your approval.
